title: AgriAI
hero_text: Upload a crop image, inspect top model predictions, review structured disease guidance, and optionally ask AI for grounded follow-up recommendations.
disease_data_not_available: Data not available for this disease in the selected language.
run_prediction_hint: Run a prediction to see disease details and confidence scores.
ask_ai_help: Ask a practical question after a prediction. This endpoint uses the disease record as grounding context.
ask_ai_placeholder: Example: What should I do in the next 24 hours for this disease?
ai_unavailable_try_again: AI is unavailable right now. Here are the key steps you can take based on the disease details.
camera_not_supported: Camera is not supported on this device.
camera_permission_error: Camera permission was denied or unavailable.
camera_capture_error: Could not capture photo. Please try again.
avoid_watering: Avoid overhead watering to reduce spread
choose_image_error: Choose an image before running prediction.
